segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided group: several describe it as gentle and non-irritating even on reactive skin, but one reviewer developed significant burning, tightness, and what she describes as barrier disruption within days of starting it, and recommends patch testing first.
segments.oily: The one reviewer who mentions her skin's oil response found it left her feeling oily and greasy, and says her dermatologist warned the combination could cause clogged pores and congestion.
segments.mature: The clearest mature-skin account, a 51-year-old using it twice daily for two months, reports visibly softer fine lines around the mouth, forehead, and under-eyes along with plumper, more hydrated skin, calling it comparable to pricier anti-aging serums.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and firmer, plumper-looking skin after a few weeks of consistent use, particularly around the eyes and mouth, but two reviewers report no visible change at all after 10 to 30 days and call the product ineffective for what it claims.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the formula as hydrating, with several specifically noting previously dehydrated or dry areas, like the forehead, looking plumper and less dry with continued use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no stinging or irritation, but one describes significant burning and facial irritation resembling a sunburn within days of starting the product, which did not improve even after simplifying her routine.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product disrupted her skin barrier, causing burning and heightened sensitivity that persisted despite simplifying her routine; she recommends patch testing before regular use, especially for reactive skin.
concerns.blemishes: The only account on this point is a single reviewer whose dermatologist warned that the product could cause clogged pores and congestion for her skin; no other reviewer in this set reports breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: The only reviewer to comment on oiliness found the serum left her skin feeling oily and greasy rather than absorbing cleanly, though no other reviewer in this set reports a similar effect.

extraits.texte: I have seen a lot on social media about using the ordinary matrixyl with the ordinary argireline solution to soften fine lines and wrinkles, and to help with skin tightening and clarity. I should have done more research before purchasing this. This product is a complete waste of money. I used it for 30 days and it does not do anything that the company claims. The product does go on and absorb into my skin easily enough, but leaves my skin feeling oily and greasy. I spoke with my Dermatologist who verified that this product or the combination of these two products from the ordinary are a complete waste of money and the only result I might see are clogged pores and more congestion! My advice is to not believe everything you see on social media and to definitely do your research before wasting your money on these products!

I started using The Ordinary Matrixyl 10% plus Hyaluronic Acid serum on February 14 and developed significant facial irritation within a few days. My skin felt tight, burning, and overly sensitive, similar to a sunburn. The irritation spread across my cheeks and did not improve even after simplifying my routine. I understand skincare is individual, but in my case this product disrupted my skin barrier and caused noticeable discomfort. I would recommend patch testing and introducing it very slowly, especially if you have sensitive or reactive skin. Clear, factual, and measured.

After 10 days use I don't see any results on my skin, I got both Argireline 10% and Materixyl 10% used 2 times daily each one, but still I don't see any results. Something like massage water on your skin. 2 star is only for the nice bottle, package and ontime. I would return them if I didn't throw away the boxes.

extraits.titre: Impressive results for mature skin—worth every drop!
extraits.texte: I’m 51 and have tried more serums than I can count, but The Ordinary Matrixyl 10% + Hyaluronic Acid has truly impressed me. I’ve been using it twice a day for about two months, and the difference in my skin is undeniable—especially around my mouth, forehead, and under-eye area. The fine lines have softened noticeably, and my skin feels plumper and hydrated all day. It absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, and it layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup. I love that it’s fragrance-free and gentle even on my sometimes sensitive skin. The price point is unbeatable for the quality—especially compared to other high-end anti-aging serums I’ve tried that didn’t deliver half these results. If you’re in your 40s, 50s, or beyond and looking for something effective, affordable, and easy to fit into your routine, I highly recommend giving this one a try. My skin looks smoother, firmer, and simply healthier. I’m officially hooked!

extraits.titre: Must have for those with sensitivities
extraits.texte: I love this product line. I have ridiculous sensitive skin and it took a long time for me to find a product that didn't irritate my skin. Their products feel so nice and hydrating. None of them are oily. Some are a little tacky when layering but I think that means you have to wait a little longer between layers. I feel the quality is great and I have seen results in a 60 day time span. I have deep forehead wrinkles that I am self conscious about and these products have done such a great job plumping my skin back out. All of the ingredients are safe for people like me with sensitivities. I was unsure how and when to layer so chatgpt whipped up a routine for me that I follow religiously. will be sticking with this line!

I have used this product for over 2 months,and I love it! Its a must in my morning routine. My forehead wrinkles were deep and skin was dehydrated. After just a few days, I started noticing the difference. And while I still have my wrinkles, they are less visible. Even noticed the difference around my eyes! Will continue to use this product!

extraits.texte: The Ordinary Matrixyl + Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a standout anti-aging formula at an unbeatable price. After just a few weeks, my skin looks noticeably firmer, smoother, and more hydrated. The Matrixyl 3000 and Matrixyl Synthe’6 peptides really do help soften fine lines, especially around my eyes and mouth. The hyaluronic acid is not super thick and gives lasting moisture without feeling sticky or heavy, and I love that it’s fragrance-free and gentle on my sensitive skin. It layers beautifully under moisturizer or makeup and works for all skin types. Used morning and night, it delivers visible results that rival high-end serums. A must-have in any skincare routine!
